name: TBG Flux Kontext Stabilizer
plain: Replaces the start of any schedule with a fixed 6-value head (1.0, .9836, .9660, .9471, .9266, .9045) taken from a hard-coded 20-step table, then keeps every input sigma below 0.9045. The step count therefore depends on how many input sigmas fall below that value. A second table in the code is never used. The head assumes a flow model with sigma in 0 to 1.
